Allows any user to log in with username/email and password and reach the role-specific dashboard.
Shows the instruction to contact the Administrator for a password reset (no self-service reset).
Allows users to change their own password, including the mandatory change after receiving a temporary password.
Displays the current user's account, roles and branch/department; provides Change Password and Logout.
Role-specific home page; for Operations Manager and Owner it shows room readiness, task workload, incident/maintenance and inventory indicators.
Lists notifications and alerts; search and filter by type, time, priority and read status.
Displays a notification, marks it as read/acknowledged and opens the related record.
Searches and filters user accounts; creates and activates/deactivates accounts.
Displays and updates an account, resets its password, assigns branch/department and roles, and shows effective permissions.
Lists system roles and creates a new role.
Updates a role and configures its permissions by feature.
Displays the permissions of all roles in one matrix (read-only overview).
Lists branches and creates a new branch.
Displays, updates and deactivates a branch; shows its structure tree of floors, areas, rooms and departments.
Lists floors and areas of a branch and creates a new floor/area.
Displays, updates and deactivates a floor/area.
Lists room types of a branch and creates a new room type.
Displays, updates and deactivates a room type.

Displays room information, current status reason and status history; updates, deactivates or reactivates the room.
Lists departments of a branch and creates a new department.
Displays, updates and deactivates a department.
Displays rooms by floor with operational status (Ready, Pending Cleaning, Cleaning, Pending Inspection, Rework, Blocked) and counts; opens next actions.

Lists rework tasks; staff see their own rework tasks.
Displays defects to fix; staff accept, start and submit the rework with remediation notes.
Displays cleaning cycles of a room with assignees, times, inspection results and rework count.
Lists inspection checklists and creates a new checklist.

Lists rooms pending inspection/reinspection and failed inspections without rework; assigns the inspector.

Displays the inspection summary and approves or rejects the room.
Creates a rework task from a failed inspection with defects, assignee and due time.

Searches inspections with results, defects, inspectors, housekeepers and checklist version.
Lists incidents by status, severity, location and deadline.
Creates an incident with location/asset, description and evidence; shows similar open incidents.

Assigns a technician and deadline to an incident.
Lists maintenance work from incidents and schedules; technicians see their own tasks.

Lists preventive maintenance schedules and creates a new schedule.
Updates a schedule and shows its executions and next due date.
Manages work categories, priority levels, status groups and interruption reasons.
Searches assets by branch, location, type and status; registers assets; shows statistics by location.
Displays and updates an asset; assigns/transfers location, records handover, updates condition, retires it.
Displays incidents, repairs and preventive maintenance history of an asset.
Lists warehouses and creates a new warehouse.
Displays stock levels and items below minimum stock for the storekeeper.
Lists inventory items and creates a new item.
Updates an item, its unit conversions and minimum stock levels per warehouse.
Lists receipts, issues, returns and transfers by type; creates a new transaction.
Verifies and posts a transaction, confirms transfer receipt, or reverses a posted transaction.
Lists stocktakes and starts a new stocktake.
Records counted quantities, reconciles discrepancies and confirms stock adjustment.
Displays current stock and movement history by warehouse, item and period.
Lists my requests, requests pending my approval and approved requests to issue; creates a request.
Updates/cancels, links to work, reviews, approves/rejects, checks availability, issues (full/partial) and returns unused materials.
Lists replenishment requests and creates a new one.
Tracks requested, pending and received quantities of a replenishment request.
Lists operational tasks (department or my tasks); creates a new task.
Sets priority/deadline, accepts, starts, pauses/resumes, updates, completes, verifies or reopens a task; logs working time.
Assigns or reassigns a task based on department and workload.
Displays tasks and time logs by employee, department, status and deadline.
Lists overdue tasks, incidents and internal requests and opens the related record.
Displays the workday calendar; creates and updates shifts and their assignees.
Displays shift time, assigned employees and status.
Staff start/end their workday; Department Head views actual start/end times.
Lists shift handovers and their acknowledgement status.
Records pending tasks, unready rooms, open incidents and requests; receiver acknowledges.
Lists internal requests in scope; creates a new request.
Routes, accepts/rejects, updates progress, links work, hands over, completes, reopens or escalates a request.
Generates and exports reports by type (room, housekeeping/inspection, incident/maintenance, asset, inventory, task), period, branch and department.
Searches audit entries by period, actor, entity and action.
Displays the actor, time, action and before/after values of a change.
